question: Should OpenClaw retire the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py` helper now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`, or keep supporting it for release/backport users?
rationale: Automation can see the latest release is affected and the linked PR fixes that old parser, but current main removed the helper and current skill guidance points at a different workflow; that is a maintainer product-boundary choice.

options.title: Retire the helper surface
options.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together after documenting that `skill_workshop` is the supported skill-creation path.

options.title: Refresh and land/backport the helper fix
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR that intentionally restores or supports the helper, preserves current tests, and adds the mixed-case parser coverage.

recommendation.title: Retire the helper surface
recommendation.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together after documenting that `skill_workshop` is the supported skill-creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill/helper history and the product-boundary decision around bundled skills route most strongly to steipete.
